title: Fixing CORS: Spring Security config vs Vite dev proxy

objectives.text: Explain that the browser stops frontend JavaScript from reading a cross-origin response unless CORS permits it, and that only requests outside the CORS-safelisted conditions trigger a preflight
Choose a Spring Security CORS configuration or a Vite dev-server proxy for a described setup
Diagnose a CORS error from the browser console and network panel
